Itineraries

A Jaisalmer heritage itinerary

Explore the carved buildings, temples and residential lanes of the old city, then head out to cenotaphs and a former Paliwal village.

Open the trip planner ↗

Day 1 — Fort and havelis

Morning

Jaisalmer Fort in depth, including its temples.

Afternoon

Patwon, Nathmal and Salim Singh havelis.

Evening

Gadisar Lake and its shrines.

Day 2 — Beyond the walls

Morning

Bada Bagh cenotaphs.

Afternoon

Kuldhara abandoned village.

Evening

Vyas Chhatris and A heritage walk through the old city's lesser-known lanes.
